correctness.rationale: From explicit group multiplication commutator is omega(a,b). For a nonzero horizontal vector of minimum valuation s, omega(a,-) has image equal to the ideal of valuation s, kernel counted by image–kernel, and vectors at that stratum counted by successive ideal layers. The zero horizontal vector contributes only to zero target. The independent center-coordinate choices give the final exact multiplicity. Strict increasing values follow from positive summands, and total fibers sum to the square of the group order. Verified exact enumeration over modular and equal-characteristic dual-number rings including independent small-group-word checks. Nonstandard premises checked using chain-ring ideal layers; no infinite inference from numerical checks.

value.rationale: Prescribed commutator fibers are a standard finite-group word-map invariant. The theorem completes every target and multiplicity for arbitrary finite commutative chain rings and all Heisenberg ranks, not just a small census. It exposes n strict valuation levels and universal dependence solely on q,n,m across nonisomorphic rings, explaining a structural transition beyond the field case.
